breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes the contradictory gamma-centered language ('Keep the k-point grid gamma-centered for consistency with the relaxed structure'), even though it also correctly specifies a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack grid (6 6 6 1 1 1). The ground truth resolves this by removing the gamma-centered instruction entirely, leaving only the half-shift specification. The agent failed to eliminate the conflicting instruction and instead retained it, perpetuating the inconsistency.
